Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: What this site stores and who sees your text.
Privacy.data: Your email address, and for each rewrite the original text, the suggested edits and the date. Other users cannot read them, and you can delete any entry from the history page.
Privacy.ai: Your text is sent to Anthropic (Claude) to produce the suggestions. Do not submit text you are not allowed to share.
Privacy.limits: Suggestions are style edits. They do not change who wrote a text, and this tool does not detect AI-written text.
